definitions.explanation: The chemical process of converting exposed photographic film into visible images.

examples.japanese: フィルムを{現像|げんぞう}に{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I sent the film out for developing.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}の{現像|げんぞう}には{暗室|あんしつ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A darkroom is needed for photo developing.

examples.japanese: {現像|げんぞう}した{写真|しゃしん}を{受|う}け{取|と}りに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to pick up the developed photos.

notes:
USAGE: While digital photography has largely replaced film, {現像|げんぞう} is still used for film photography enthusiasts. The term is also used in digital contexts for RAW file processing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{現像|げんぞう}に{出|だ}す (to send out for developing)
・{現像|げんぞう}する (to develop)
・{即日|そくじつ}{現像|げんぞう} (same-day developing)
・{現像液|げんぞうえき} (developing solution)

PHOTOGRAPHY TERMS:
・{暗室|あんしつ} - darkroom
・ネガ/ネガティブ - negative
・{焼|や}き{増|ま}し - reprint
・{引|ひ}き{伸|の}ばし - enlargement

MODERN USAGE: In digital photography, {現像|げんぞう} is sometimes used for RAW file processing (RAW{現像|げんぞう}).
